name: Segun Samuel Complete Platform Build
notes: Strengthened /search/ visual hierarchy and discovery controls.
Strengthened /explore/ Knowledge Graph framing and relationship discovery.
JOIN EVENT LIST on all event detail pages now opens a first-party registration modal.
Event registration collects name, email, organisation, interest and consent.
Email delivery/provider integration intentionally deferred for later mail-strategy decision.
Podcast index and detail hero artwork is contained strictly within the hero section.
Podcast hero height is constrained and responsive rather than viewport-sized.
Search and Explore receive an additional editorial visual-polish layer without changing their core information architecture.
Corrected podcast index and all podcast detail heroes after visual QA.
Hero artwork is now explicitly constrained to the hero box and cannot create viewport-height behavior.
Removed viewport-height sizing from the final hero contract.
Foreground content is protected by a controlled readability gradient rather than being treated as a separate image column.
Responsive hero heights are explicitly capped for desktop, tablet and mobile.
Recomposed /books/ landing hero into a compact editorial two-column structure.
Featured book cover and featured copy now occupy one horizontal composition instead of stacking vertically.
Reduced desktop and mobile hero padding and tightened featured typography/actions.
Preserved existing book content, links, imagery and information architecture.
